title: Grateful Dead Live at Aztec Bowl, San Diego State U. on 1969-05-11
venue: Aztec Bowl, San Diego State U.
lineage: DAT (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition 2022 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/48k

ai_review.summary: Rough FM tape but an energized spring‑groove set highlighted by a solid Alligator performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is a lo‑fi FM source that cleans up only intermittently, giving it a rough, uneven sound. Musically the band sounds highly energized, with an extended percussion focus and a noteworthy rendition of "Alligator" that keeps listeners engaged despite the technical limitations.

ai_rating.rationale: One mixed review (3 stars) notes strong performance energy versus a rough, low‑fidelity tape; weighted estimate yields ~3.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FM broadcast tape with occasional clean moments but overall rough and uneven mix; no full soundboard quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic spring‑groove feel with extended percussion sections; the flow is lively despite lack of detailed set information.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for leading a percussion-heavy segment and delivering progressive, sustained guitar work.
band_member_comments.Drums: More drums highlighted; percussion ensemble noted as a focal point.
